items.title: Live: Trump warns 'entire civilisation will die' if Iran ultimatum expires
items.description: The US president says "we will find out tonight" whether Iran has agreed to a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, with his deadline set to expire in a matter of hours. Follow live.

items.title: Thousands of sites taken down as experts warn AI is increasing scams
items.description: Almost 12,000 scam websites have been shut down by Australia's financial regulator in a year as it continues a "cat-and-mouse game" with cybercriminals.

items.title: Ben Roberts-Smith's Australian War Memorial display to be reviewed
items.description: The Australian War Memorial will review its display of Ben Roberts-Smith, who has been charged with committing war crimes.

items.title: Ben Roberts-Smith charged with five counts of the war crime of murder
items.description: One of Australia's most decorated soldiers, Ben Roberts-Smith, was arrested at Sydney Airport's domestic terminal this morning.

items.title: Kanye West blocked from entering UK to headline music festival
items.description: The British government's decision forces London's Wireless festival to cancel the event.

items.title: 'I'm not worried about it': Donald Trump's shifting rhetoric on the Iran war
items.description: Donald Trump's increasingly erratic language means that a US president's word — which would have once been regarded with gravitas — holds perhaps only the same weight as the word of the "evil" regime he says he has obliterated several times.

items.title: Police charge international baby trafficking syndicate in Indonesia
items.description: Babies, some as young as three months, were allegedly sold to people in Singapore and across Indonesia.

items.title: David Warner charged with mid-range drink driving
items.description: Former Australian Test cricketer David Warner is charged with mid-range drink driving in Sydney's east over the weekend.

items.title: Artemis II reveals previously unseen views of far side of the Moon
items.description: The astronauts have travelled further from Earth than any humans before, capturing never-before-seen views of the far side of the Moon.

items.title: Passengers vomiting 'up and down' aisles as Fiji flight aborts three landings
items.description: A Fiji Airways flight from Sydney had to divert after bad weather from a tropical cyclone thwarted its attempts to land.

items.title: Graffiti on iconic tourist attraction investigated as possible hate speech
items.description: The graffiti, criticising Israel, was sprayed onto Coffs Harbour's famous Big Banana over the Easter long weekend.

items.title: Tourist hotspots share how fuel crisis impacted long weekend visitors
items.description: It was a mixed weekend for many tourism businesses across the country, amid fears that rising fuel costs would keep people home. For some, it was business as usual, but fuel uncertainty has many in the sector feeling nervous about the months ahead.

items.title: Nine weeks of rolling phone, internet outages in remote NT community
items.description: Wadeye, one of Australia's largest Aboriginal communities, has been without a stable mobile phone service for months, leaving locals unable to make calls or access the internet.

items.title: Vegan leather sounds eco‑friendly but the truth is complex
items.description: As fashion brands move away from animal leather, "vegan" has come to suggest something that is both kinder to animals and better for the planet. However, the reality is more complicated.

items.title: Gold Coast mother pleads not guilty to murdering son with spiked smoothie
items.description: Maree Mavis Crabtree has pleaded not guilty to the murder of her son Jonathan in 2017, his attempted murder earlier that year, and attempted fraud.

items.title: Tributes for Aboriginal health leader and The Sapphires singer
items.description: Dr Naomi Mayers helped establish the first Aboriginal medical services in Australia, turning self-determination into a model of care across the country. Her death came days before Wiradjuri woman and "fierce trailblazer" Ann Weldon.

items.title: 'MAGA for Mamdani': The issue flipping Trump voters to a left-wing Democrat
items.description: US President Donald Trump and New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani are from polar opposite ends of the political spectrum, but comic Ron Barba voted for them both.

items.title: I am tired of constantly defending being single and child-free
items.description: I might be on a different path, but I can still love and be loved in ways that don't require me to be a mother or a partner.

items.title: ABC Places quiz: Where in the world are we?
items.description: Today's ABC Places quiz features photos from 10 locations around the world. Your challenge is to guess where you are.

items.title: 'They are torturing the public': Inside India's cooking gas crisis
items.description: Across Delhi, people are waiting days and sometimes weeks for gas cylinders. Yet, the ABC has found a thriving black market, where the same gas can be bought quickly — for those who can afford it.

items.title: Trump threatens 'demolition' of Iran and takes another swipe at Australia
items.description: Donald Trump says the "entire country" of Iran will be "taken out" if no deal is reached by Wednesday morning (AEST), ratcheting up his threat to target civilian infrastructure and brushing off concerns it would be a war crime.

items.title: Trump threatens to jail journalist who broke story of US rescue mission in Iran
items.description: US President Donald Trump is threatening to jail the journalist who broke the story about the rescue of a downed US airman in Iran, as more details about the daring recovery mission are made public.

items.title: Coke bottles to a 200L drum: Petrol stations see dangerous fuel stockpiling
items.description: Authorities are warning that improper or excessive storage of petrol or diesel in suburban homes carries a significant fire risk, as service station owners report excessive stockpiling.

items.title: New EV sales data proves fuel crisis sparks consumer shift
items.description: EV sales have surged in March, a month into the war in Iran. But it is not the only signal indicating a move away from fuel cars.

items.title: The only team sport that won't feel the wrath of gambling reform
items.description: The ex-CEO of Netball Australia said it was behind the times when she walked out the door in December 2023, but new gambling reforms announced by the federal government show the sport was right to steer clear from sports betting.
